meta.title: Highway Engineer
meta.tagline: Design and build roads and highways that connect communities.
meta.description: Highway engineers design road networks, geometric alignments, pavement structures and drainage systems for safe and efficient transportation infrastructure.

details.description: Highway engineers design road networks, geometric alignments, pavement structures and drainage systems for safe and efficient transportation infrastructure.
details.whyLearn: Design and build roads and highways that connect communities. Highway engineers design road networks, geometric alignments, pavement structures and drainage systems for safe and efficient transportation infrastructure.
objectives: Build a complete foundation in highway engineer
Complete hands-on projects for your portfolio
interviewQuestions: Why do you want to become a highway engineer?
Walk me through a project you're proud of
How do you keep your skills up to date?
details.careerRelevance: Highway Engineer is a Moderate demand career with typical salaries of $65k-$120k+.
tips: Follow this roadmap in order
Build and publish projects at every stage
Join communities and network
